name: envUI
description: envUI's design tokens. The base set holds every token with its light, standard-contrast, comfortable value; each modifier context overrides only the tokens it changes. npm run tokens:build turns them into packages/ui/src/styles/Tokens.css and the generated token modules.

base.description: Every token, as the light color scheme at standard contrast and comfortable scale shows it, plus two internal groups: the primitive palette (generated by scripts/build/GeneratePalette.ts) and the light scheme's high-contrast values.

colorScheme.description: Light is the base set; dark gives every color role its dark grade, and holds the dark scheme's high-contrast values. Theme writes the scheme to data-env-theme.

contrast.description: High contrast: text at least 7:1 and every boundary, indicator and focus ring at least 4.5:1, 70 and 50 grades apart. It points the roles that change at the current scheme's high-contrast values. Built as [data-env-contrast='high'], and under prefers-contrast: more unless data-env-contrast='standard'.

scale.description: The app scale. Comfortable is the base set; compact is about 0.8 of it in geometry and one step down in type, with a 1 rem icon floor and fixed borders and focus rings. Built as [data-env-scale='compact'], which Theme writes from its scale prop on every boundary, and under pointer: fine for every boundary but a comfortable one, so the system scale, the default, is compact on desktop.
